messages:
maria: quick sketch of a coordinator-driven reconcile for manifests + tombstone propagation. trying to avoid situations where some nodes see tombstones and others still serve stale cached keys. posting outline before i write an RFC.

kevin: tl;dr?

maria: coordinator keeps "manifest intent" and a per-prefix tombstone_watermark (epoch when tombstone was emitted). nodes applying an evict/demote include tombstone_epoch when they emit tombstone markers. coordinator waits for acknowledgements that tombstone_epoch >= intent.watermark before marking entry done.

sam: how do reads behave when tombstone acks are pending? we still want linearizable read-after-write for pinned prefixes.

maria: readpath rule: if prefix in pending_manifest_set and local tombstone_epoch < manifest.watermark, readpath consults owner or returns a transient 409/RETRY-READ hint. cheap guard to avoid serving stale value.

anita: ops: sounds reasonable. what about long-tail nodes that are slow? we can't block forever.

maria: coordinator policy: per-entry deadline + degradation path. after deadline we mark entry PARTIAL and emit 'tombstone-propagation-hint' to rehydrate or run read-repair background job. also provide abort/compensate actions in UI.

kevin: sample manifest shape?

maria: minimal: ```json
{
  "manifest_id": "m-1812349990-a",
  "epoch": 4096,
  "entries": [
    {"prefix":"tenant/7/pfxA","op":"evict","expected_ver":42,"tombstone_epoch":4096}
  ],
  "watermark": 4096
}
```

sam: ok. what about tombstone compaction? if node compacts tombstones away quickly we might lose ability to prove propagation.

maria: manifest stores a short-lived audit-log entry (manifest_id -> tombstone_digest) for retention window (e.g., 10m). nodes can reconstruct or request missing tombstone hints. compaction beyond retention means we treat missing proof as transient failure and retry or run background repair.

anita: telemetry + alerts? ops-bot: suggest metrics: tombstone-ack-latency, tombstone-missing-rate, manifest-partial-rate, read-retry-rate. alert if tombstone-missing-rate spikes.

ops-bot: infra-note: recommend default tombstone-retention 600s and manifest-deadline 120s for hosted clusters.

kevin: tests: add chaos for slow nodes, tombstone GC before ack, and owner transfer mid-manifest. assert readpath either blocks or triggers repair and eventually consistent state.

maria: i'll prototype in staging with canary manifests and small defaults. will follow up with RFC including API shapes, ops playbook for abort/compensate, and the readpath guard change. anyone want to pair on chaos tests?

sam: i'll join later today.

anita: i'll draft ops playbook and dashboard mockups.

maria: thanks all ":thumbsup:"
